description: Turns your forecast of Bitcoin's settlement price into a trade on this week's market and returns unsigned transactions (approve, then buy) to sign and send in order. Give EITHER quantiles (easiest) OR probs. It buys more where you're more confident than the crowd. Budget is in tUSDC including the fee, 1 to 10000.

budget.description: tUSDC to spend, fee included. maxCost adds your slippage allowance on top

probs.description: Alternative: one probability per price range from get_market, in index order. Normalized for you.

quantiles.description: Your forecast as BTC prices in USD at the 5th, 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, 90th and 95th percentiles, e.g. [76000, 77500, 79500, 81000, 82500, 84500, 86000]

slippageBps.description: Price-move allowance in basis points, default 100

wallet.description: Your wallet, to check balance and skip the approval if it's already granted

name: build_order
title: Build a trade from a forecast
